description: This file defines the LeaveRequestSearchFilterParams class, a Data Transfer Object (DTO) used for filtering leave requests based on various criteria such as status, employee number, subunit, leave type, and inclusion options. It extends DateRangeSearchFilterParams and interacts with the Leave entity and leave request services.

classes.name: LeaveRequestSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering leave requests with criteria such as statuses, employee info, subunit, leave type, and inclusion options. It provides validation and mapping functionality for these filters.

methods.name: getStatuses
methods.description: Returns the array of leave statuses to filter by.

methods.name: setStatuses
methods.description: Sets the leave statuses after validating against predefined allowed statuses; translates statuses to internal representations.

methods.name: getEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns the array of employee numbers for filtering.

methods.name: setEmpNumbers
methods.description: Sets the array of employee numbers.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeId
methods.description: Returns the leave type ID filter.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeId
methods.description: Sets the leave type ID filter.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns the inclusion option for employees.

methods.name: setIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Sets the inclusion option for employees.
